mintAuthority.summary: DUSD is a non-proxy token owned by AltoTimelockController, historically controlled by the 4-of-7 Alto Safe with a 3600-second minimum delay. Current minters have ceilings, but owner-only minter admission and ceiling changes can authorize any address without token-level collateral checks. D14 classifies root native issuance as economically unbounded, regardless of current minter collateral gates.

controls.label: AltoTimelockController (DUSD owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, DUSD.owner() = 0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86. Verified DUSD source restricts setMinterStatus and setMinterCeiling to onlyOwner, so this timelock can add/revoke a minter and raise or lower any token-level ceiling. Its getMinDelay() is 3600 seconds; existing RoleGranted/RoleRevoked evidence resolves the proposer/executor Safe and revocation of deployer roles.

controls.label: Alto governance Safe (proposer/executor on timelock)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26096016 on 2026-10-01, getOwners() returned the seven listed owners, getThreshold() returned 4, VERSION() returned 1.4.1, and getModulesPaginated(sentinel,100) returned no enabled modules. hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE), hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE), and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) for this Safe all returned true on the token-owner timelock, whose getMinDelay() remained 3600 seconds. This supersedes the prior 3-of-5 owner configuration; signer key independence is not inferred.

review.evidence: Historical block 25540452 review found 11 active minters among 13 event addresses and a 3-of-5 Alto Safe. At Ethereum block 26096016 on 2026-10-01, a fresh full SetMinterStatus census returned 22 events with no next page, covering 20 unique addresses; pinned allowedMinter/minterConfig reads found 18 active and two inactive. The Safe is now 4-of-7 and holds proposer, executor and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the token-owner timelock, with getMinDelay()=3600. Verified DUSD source restricts mint to active minters within their ceilings, and onlyOwner can change status or ceilings. Newly admitted minters are recorded as token-level capped contracts, without asserting that their underlying collateral/upgrade gates were fully reviewed. D14/D29 review on 2026-10-03 confirmed owner() remains AltoTimelockController at Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a). Verified setMinterStatus(address,bool) and setMinterCeiling(address,uint256) admit arbitrary addresses; mint(address,uint256) checks only authorization and ceiling, not posted collateral. The owner can authorize a chosen minter, raise its ceiling and cause durable unbacked supply to any recipient without upgrading. Semantics are unbounded; Safe-rooted delay is not D29 token governance. Not-applicable reconciliation and no supervision derive unbounded-unreconciled.
